svg.title: Professional journey timeline
svg.desc: 2023 — Present: BS Artificial Intelligence — Third-year undergraduate. Coursework that turned into real systems: neural networks, natural language processing and software engineering. | Deep learning: XDL-IDS · CNN-Attention-GRU — Extended a published CAN-bus intrusion detector with multi-head self-attention and tested it on a merged CICIoV2024 + Car Hacking dataset, with SHAP explainability. | LLM systems: La Bella Tavola assistant — Built a fully local reservation assistant: slot extraction and a state machine around a small LLM, voice in and out, RAG with tool calls, and an evaluation suite. | ML in production: Zameen Intelligence Platform — Shipped a lead-intelligence product for Karachi real estate that scrapes, segments and scores new listings every morning and redeploys its API and dashboard. | Automation: Lead Scraping & Outreach — Designed a Celery + Redis job system that scrapes Google Maps, enriches leads with web, LinkedIn and social data, syncs them to Google Sheets and runs staggered outreach. | Now: Agentic AI and applied LLM systems — Going deeper on agents, voice interfaces and the MLOps needed to keep models reliable after deployment.
